class: A gate command piped into a filter (`gate | tail`, `gate | grep`) takes the filter's exit status, so a following `&& push` / `&& merge` runs even when the gate failed; chaining with && is not enough when the gate's output is piped.
mechanism: The W-024 round-10 builder ran the CI mirror piped to tail and chained the push with &&; tail exited 0, the pricing-scan failure did not stop the push, and a red branch reached origin.

first_seen.evidence: builder report: ci_local 12 passed, 2 failed (tests/engine/test_pricing_scan.py) yet `git push` ran in the same && chain after `| tail`

fix: Run a gate as its own command (no pipe), or with `set -o pipefail`, and read its summary from the log file it writes; briefs state this rule.

detection.note: Candidate mechanism: a PreToolUse hook refusing a Bash command where a known gate (ci_local, pytest, merge_when_green) is piped and followed by && push/merge without pipefail. Build at the second occurrence (learning L2).

occurrences.evidence: red branch pushed past a piped gate
